dialogue.content: 今日は宜しくお願いします。（時間になりましたら始めさせていただきます。）
dialogue.English: I look forward to working with you today. (We’ll begin once it’s time.)

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。相談に来ていただいてありがとうございます。よろしければ、年齢、性別、なんとお呼びすればいいのか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm a counselor here. Thank you for coming in today. If you don't mind, could you tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like me to call you?

dialogue.content: 高3女子るりです
dialogue.English: I'm Ruri, a third-year high school student.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？話しやすいところからお話下さいね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today? Please feel free to start wherever is most comfortable for you.

dialogue.content: 進路についてです
dialogue.English: It's about my path after graduation.

dialogue.content: いきなり親に大学行くなら国立大学と言われました
dialogue.English: My parent suddenly told me that if I go to university, it has to be a national university.

dialogue.content: 今の成績では厳しいです
dialogue.English: With my current grades, it's tough.

dialogue.content: 私立なら短大か専門しかダメと言われました
dialogue.English: She said if it's a private school, it can only be a junior college or a vocational school.

dialogue.content: 最悪です
dialogue.English: It's the worst.

dialogue.content: なるほど。いきなりは厳しいですよね。誰に言われたんですか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very tough to hear out of the blue. Who told you that?

dialogue.content: 母親です
dialogue.English: My mother.

dialogue.content: 推薦狙ってがんばってきたのに
dialogue.English: Even though I've been working so hard to get in on a recommendation.

dialogue.content: やる気がなくなりました
dialogue.English: I've lost all my motivation.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・今まで頑張ってきたのに突然そんなことを言われるとやる気がなくなりますよね・・
dialogue.English: I can understand that. After working so hard, it's natural to lose your motivation when you're suddenly told something like that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: お母さんにそう言われた時何か言い返したりはしたんですか？
dialogue.English: When your mother said that, did you say anything back?

dialogue.content: そんなこと急に言われても困ると言いました
dialogue.English: I told her it's troubling to be told something like that so suddenly.

dialogue.content: でもお金がないから仕方がないと言われました
dialogue.English: But she said it can't be helped because there's no money.

dialogue.content: どうすることもできません
dialogue.English: There's nothing I can do.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。そう言いますよね。お金がないと言われたんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see. That makes sense that she would say that. So she told you it was because there's no money...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 母親も困ってるので仕方ないです
dialogue.English: My mother is in a tough spot too, so I guess it can't be helped.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね・・こんな状況でもお母さんのことを気遣っているんですね。優しいですね。
dialogue.English: I see... Even in this situation, you're still considerate of your mother. That's very kind of you.

dialogue.content: 母親もがんばってるので仕方ないです
dialogue.English: My mother is doing her best too, so it can't be helped.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・辛いですよね・・ちなみに推薦を狙って頑張ってきたとおっしゃってましたが、どんなところを狙っていたんですか？
dialogue.English: I understand... That must be painful for you. You mentioned that you were working hard for a recommendation; what kind of school were you aiming for?

dialogue.content: 家から通えるところです
dialogue.English: Somewhere I can commute to from home.

dialogue.content: 語学を学べる人気な大学です
dialogue.English: It's a popular university where I can study languages.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。人気なんですね。大学ではどんなことをしたいと思っているんですか？
dialogue.English: I see, so it's a popular one. What were you hoping to do at university?

dialogue.content: 英語が好きなので語学を身につけたいです。
dialogue.English: I like English, so I want to build my language skills.

dialogue.content: それは素晴らしいですね。英語ができるといろんな人とコミュニケーションがとれますよね。
dialogue.English: That's wonderful. Being able to speak English lets you communicate with all kinds of people.

dialogue.content: でもいい進路先が見つかりません。
dialogue.English: But I can't find a good path forward.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・少し話を整理してもいいですか？
dialogue.English: I understand... Would it be okay if I summarize what we've talked about?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: るりさんは、突然大学に行くなら国立しかダメと言われた。今の成績ではそれはなかなか厳しい感じである。
dialogue.English: Ruri-san, you were suddenly told that if you want to go to university, it must be a national one. And with your current grades, that seems quite difficult.

dialogue.content: 今まで推薦で近所の大学を狙っていた。そこで語学の勉強をしたいと思っていた。お母さんも頑張っているので気持ちはわかっている。でも、無理かもとわかりやる気がでなくなってしまった。いかがですか？
dialogue.English: You had been aiming for a recommendation to a nearby university where you wanted to study languages. You understand your mother's feelings because she's also doing her best. But now that you realize it might be impossible, you've lost your motivation. Is that about right?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 近くの大学は自分も憧れてきたし誰もが認めてくれる大学なんです
dialogue.English: The university nearby is one I've always dreamed of, and it's a well-respected school that everyone acknowledges.

dialogue.content: でも行けなくなりました。
dialogue.English: But now I can't go.

dialogue.content: 憧れの大学だったんですね・・そう考えると寂しくなりますよね・・
dialogue.English: So it was your dream university... It must feel sad to think about that...

dialogue.content: 悔しいです
dialogue.English: I'm so frustrated.

dialogue.content: 多分行けると思ってたのに
dialogue.English: I really thought I could get in.

dialogue.content: 行けないなんて最悪です。
dialogue.English: To think I can't go... it's just the worst.

dialogue.content: 悔しいですよね・・頑張ってきたんですよね・・るりさんの今の状況が少しでもいい方向になるように一緒に考えていきましょうね。
dialogue.English: It is frustrating, isn't it? You've worked so hard... Let's think together about how we can make your current situation even a little bit better.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: そのためにももう少し詳しく教えてくださいね。ちなみにお父さんはなんて言っているんですか？
dialogue.English: To help with that, could you tell me a little more? By the way, what does your father say about this?

dialogue.content: 父親が作った借金のせいなので
dialogue.English: It’s because of the debt my father incurred, so…

dialogue.content: 何も言いません
dialogue.English: He doesn't say anything.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・借金があるんですね・・すぐに返せる額ではないってことですね・・なんとも言えないですよね・・
dialogue.English: I see… so there’s debt. It sounds like it’s not an amount that can be repaid quickly... It’s hard to know what to say...

dialogue.content: 私にはどれくらいなのかはわかりません。
dialogue.English: I don't know how much it is.

dialogue.content: 私にはどうにもできません。
dialogue.English: There's nothing I can do about it.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・どうしようもないところが悔しいですのよね・・
dialogue.English: I understand... That feeling of helplessness must be what's so frustrating...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 友達はみんな楽しそうなのに
dialogue.English: All my friends seem so happy,

dialogue.content: なんで私だけって思います。
dialogue.English: and I can't help but think, 'Why me?'

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・自分だけって思いますよね・・このことについて誰かに相談したことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I can understand that. It's natural to feel like you're the only one. Have you talked to anyone about this?

dialogue.content: したことありません。
dialogue.English: No, I haven't.

dialogue.content: どうにもなりません。
dialogue.English: It wouldn't change anything.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・なかなか相談しにくいですよね・・投げやりな気持ちにもなってしまいますよね・・
dialogue.English: I see... It's a difficult thing to talk about, isn't it? It's understandable that you would start to feel like giving up...

dialogue.content: やる気がなくなりました
dialogue.English: I've lost my motivation.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・お話を聞いていて感じたことをお話してもいいですか？
dialogue.English: I understand... Would it be okay if I share something I felt while listening to you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今、志望校に行けないかもとやる気がでないよになっていますよね。
dialogue.English: Right now, you're feeling unmotivated because you might not be able to go to your top-choice university.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でもまだやれることはあるかもと私は思いました。
dialogue.English: However, I believe there might still be things you can do.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: Really?

dialogue.content: 例えば奨学金って知ってますか？
dialogue.English: For example, have you heard of scholarships or student loans?

dialogue.content: しりません
dialogue.English: No, I haven't.

dialogue.content: 国や、企業が大学に行くお金を貸してくれたりします。返さなくていい場合もあります。
dialogue.English: The government or companies can lend you money for university. In some cases, they are grants that you don't have to pay back.

dialogue.content: そんなのがあるんですか
dialogue.English: Is there really something like that?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でもよくわからないし気力がわきません。
dialogue.English: But I don't really understand it, and I don't have the energy.

dialogue.content: なので、諦めるのはまだ早いと思いますよ。どんなものがあるのかリンクを送りますね。https://www.syougakukin.net/what/who/kouko.htmlそれから、学校の先生にも相談したほうがいいと思いますがいかがですか？
dialogue.English: That's why I think it's too soon to give up. I'll send you a link so you can see what's available. https://www.syougakukin.net/what/who/kouko.html Also, I think it would be a good idea to talk to a teacher at your school. What do you think?

dialogue.content: とりあえず担任に相談してみます。
dialogue.English: I'll try talking to my homeroom teacher first.

dialogue.content: 担任の先生もきっと相談にのってくれると思いますよ。まだ奨学金が何なのかわからないので、やる気がでないのは無理ないと思います。奨学金についてみるだけでもいいので見てくださいね。
dialogue.English: I'm sure your homeroom teacher will be happy to help you. It's perfectly normal not to feel motivated when you don't know much about financial aid yet. Just taking a look at the information is a good first step, so please check it out.

dialogue.content: わかりました。
dialogue.English: Okay, I will.

dialogue.content: 先生にも聞いてみます。
dialogue.English: I'll ask my teacher about it, too.

dialogue.content: 先生が詳しく教えてくれると思いますよ。また、学校でどんな話になったのか教えてくださいね。
dialogue.English: I'm sure your teacher can give you more details. Please let me know how your conversation at school goes, if you'd like.

dialogue.content: わかりました。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 他には何か相談したいことがありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else you’d like to talk about?

dialogue.content: もう大丈夫です
dialogue.English: No, I'm okay for now.

dialogue.content: では今日はこれで終了にしたいと思いますね。自分が辛い状況でも両親のことを気遣えるるりさんは、強くて優しいと感じました。まだまだ、志望校にいくためには、いろんな方法があると思うので諦めないでほしいと思いました。
dialogue.English: Then let's end our session for today. I felt that you, Ruri-san, are strong and kind for being able to think of your parents even when you're in a tough situation yourself. I want you to know that there are still many ways to get into your dream university, so I hope you don't give up.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 時間ですよね。今日はありがとうございました。勉強になりました。またよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is up. Thank you for today. It was a learning experience for me. I look forward to speaking with you again.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.English: Thank you, as well. I appreciate your time.

dialogue.content: それではロールプレイを終了しますね。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Alright, we will now end the role-play. Thank you.
